title: Ofcom Proposes Methods for Social Media Age Verification
excerpt: Ofcom suggests photo IDs, digital identification, banking checks, and facial estimation to verify users are 16 or older.
body_html:
Regulator Ofcom has detailed several approaches that social media platforms can use to confirm that users are at least 16 years old.

According to the guidance, platforms can implement photo identification, digital IDs, banking verification checks, or facial age estimation technology to determine user ages.
